title: Reading pocket
idea: Reading pocket: A comfortable text column and quiet progress anchor
audience: People who need to read within a mobile surface.
worksWellWhen: Long-form reading is the core activity
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic document layout through its read priority and explicit commitment contract: Restore reading position without hiding new content
navigation: Reading pocket keeps the current read context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A comfortable text column and quiet progress anchor
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to read; long-form reading is the core activity
composition.priority: Restore reading position without hiding new content

imagery.role: Support the actual read context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Support text enlargement without horizontal text scrolling
Respect safe areas, native text scaling, keyboard intrusion and platform back behavior.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the reading pocket structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no read content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Restore reading position without hiding new content
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized read content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Restore reading position without hiding new content
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active read context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure on target devices; test interrupted/resumed state and low-memory restoration.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
